messages:
marta: Heads-up: scheduled targeted runtime tweak for eu-west tonight 23:45 UTC. Changes: kernel micro-patch + quantization-profile tweak + model pin to redwood-v2-compact. Customer window ~23:45-00:30 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy staged: runtime-eu-quant-opt-2026-03-21. Canary: 4 nodes (5% traffic) on eu-dedicated-02. Plan: canary -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on 2m sustained 5xx >1% or p99 > baseline*1.4.

jason: Can someone draft the status page line? Keep it minimal — ops will handle internal playbook.

marta: Draft status blurb: "Planned maintenance: brief runtime update in EU (kernel & model pin). Date: 2026-03-21 23:45 UTC. Most customers unaffected; a small number may see transient retries during canary. Updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864212500"

nina: Add fallback note: "If issues occur, traffic will fall back to redwood-v2-compact-fallback automatically."

ops_sre: Preflight checklist: 1) curl /health on canary nodes -> 200 2) run small inference smoke with long prompt set 3) snapshot KV cache 4) watch p50/p99 and 5xx. Abort if 5xx >1% for 2m OR p99 +40% for 3m.

emily: Email snippet for customers:

emily: Subject: Planned maintenance  EU inference runtime  Mar 21 23:45 UTC

emily: Body: "We will perform a short maintenance update to our EU runtime on Mar 21 at 23:45 UTC. This includes a model pin (redwood-v2-compact) to ensure stability during the change. Most requests will continue normally; a small set may experience brief retries during canary. We'll post progress at: https://status.redwood.ai/"

jason: Internal rollback procedure (short):

jason: ```Trigger thresholds: - Canary 5xx >= 1% for 2 continuous minutes - Canary p99 >= baseline*1.4 for 3 minutes - Requests returning malformed tokens or severe decode errors - Customer P1 reports indicating wrong outputs
Actions: - Pause rollout and set canary traffic to 0% - Re-pin to redwood-v2-compact-stable - Post immediate update on status + ping support duty list - If affected traffic > 8%, open incident channel and escalate to SRE lead```

support-bot: Reminder set: publish status update at 2026-03-21T23:25:00Z (20m prior).

nina: Quick QA note: dedicated and private customers should be unaffected unless we target their pools. Add line for customers: "Dedicated/private pools are only changed if explicitly scheduled; contact your account rep for exceptions."

marta: please thumbs up if ready to schedule. @jason @ops_sre @nina

ops_sre: :thumbsup:

jason: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

emily: I'll queue the statuspage and send email to low-priority list at 23:30 UTC.

marta: Canary started. Monitoring windows open.

deploybot: Canary pulse (3m): 5xx 0.12%, p99 +10%. No immediate rollback. Proceeding to 20% in 5m.

ops_sre: Noted slight GC pause on one host, excluding it from the next tranche. No user-facing errors.

marta: Exclude host and continue. Keep eyes on p99.

deploybot: Tranche to 20% complete. Holding for 8m.

jason: I'm drafting a short FAQ answer for Support: "Why was my model pinned?" -> "We pinned redwood-v2-compact to avoid runtime flakiness during kernel changes; pin will be reverted if no issues."

emily: Statuspage live: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864212500  scheduled publish at 2026-03-21T23:25:00Z

support-bot: Email blast sent to low-priority list (23:30 UTC).

marta: 60% rollout moving now. Ops, flag if anything > threshold.

deploybot: 60% complete. Metrics: 5xx 0.09%, p99 +12% vs baseline.

ops_sre: 60% window clean. Proceed to 100%.

deploybot: 100% rollout complete at 00:18 UTC. No rollback triggered.

jason: Closing internal playbook note and archiving incident stub. Please file a brief postmortem if customers report anomalies.

emily: Final status update posted: maintenance finished, no widespread impact.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864212500  resolved at 2026-03-21T00:20:00Z
